dataset_identity.source_reference: UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 602 (Dry Bean), doi 10.24432/C50S4B
dataset_identity.acquisition_note: The study materializes dataset.csv as pandas to_csv(index=False) of the ucimlrepo frame. The file is gitignored in Atlas; the engine executes only when SHA-256 and size match.

compatibility_policy.rationale: The protocol depends on scikit-learn search, CV, estimator and metric semantics and on pandas CSV parsing, stable within a minor release line. A different interpreter patch or CPU architecture is recorded as a compatible difference; its numerical consequences are bounded by the tolerance policy and byte-level identity is reported separately as runtime identity.

decision_rule.rationale: The study's final evaluation takes the argmax over probabilities realigned from estimator order to public order; exact ties are counted in the evidence.

membership.semantics: source-order-bound full-row hash plus occurrence ordinal; technical partition evidence only, not entity identity

definitions.log_loss: mean negative natural log of the probability assigned to the observed class, probabilities clipped at float eps; columns mapped to classes through estimator.classes_
definitions.minimum_per_class_recall: minimum over classes of per-class recall
definitions.cv_log_loss: scikit-learn neg_log_loss scorer, reported in natural orientation

evaluation.cross_validation: train only, same folds as the family search
evaluation.validation: fit on train, evaluate once on validation

policies.derivation: train-only exploration: ShapeFactor2 has a declared dependency that could not be confirmed (unresolved provenance)
train-only exploration: the nine derived features whose dependency was confirmed from retained columns

selection.study_rule_reference: scripts/select_models.py::select_multiclass_candidate_model (lexicographic minimum of the ordered key over the tie group; equivalent to applying the breakers in order)

final_evaluation.fit_row_order: train rows then validation rows, each in source order (pandas concat, ignore_index)

confusion_pairs.focal_pairs_provenance: focal pairs frozen before test access (validation confusion and train-only overlap evidence); descriptive only

repeated_profile_sensitivity.interpretation: Sensitivity only: the official test artifact remains complete; Repeated-profile evidence does not prove duplicate identity or leakage.

exact_elements: confusion matrix with its class order
tolerance_policy.rationale: Reference values are recorded at full float precision. The reference run used CPython 3.13.13 on linux-aarch64 with the locked scikit-learn 1.9.0 / pandas 3.0.5 / numpy 2.5.3 / scipy 1.18.1 / joblib 1.5.3; an Atlas run may differ in architecture or patch level, where floating-point reduction order can perturb probabilities in the last digits. 1e-6 is three orders of magnitude below the study's own practical-tie tolerance (0.002) and far below one prediction change on 2,042 rows (~5e-4 in accuracy), so no difference inside it can change a scientific conclusion, while any changed prediction still fails through the exact confusion-matrix, per-class support and count comparisons.

The two HistGradientBoosting candidates with and without `ShapeFactor2` form a practical validation tie
The tie is resolved by the first predefined criterion, higher validation balanced accuracy, in favour of `all_features`.

evidence_gaps.description: The feature-policy column lists come from the study's train-only exploration handoff, a gitignored artifact. canonical-run.json pins only the feature counts (16/15/7) and the selected projection. Atlas declares the lists in this contract (re-derived by executing the study's official notebooks at the pinned revision) and checks their counts against canonical-run.json; Atlas does not re-execute the study's exploration.

canonical-run.json does not record the family shortlist, the practical-tie group or the deciding tie-break criterion as structured fields; they are compared against README text at the pinned revision.

canonical-run.json records CV macro-F1 mean/std for every family and candidate but secondary CV metrics only for the selected candidate; other secondary CV values are reported by Atlas without a reference.

The study's final-model artifact SHA-256 and model-state fingerprint are joblib/pickle and runtime specific; Atlas does not serialize or compare model bytes. Byte-level runtime identity is represented by the probability-matrix SHA-256 in the runtime_identity group.

historical_test_exposure.description: The seed-42 test partition was also evaluated once by the superseded pre-correction execution. The corrected run re-derived every development decision from training-only evidence with the pre-declared seed, candidate space, metric, and tie rules; none of them was changed after that historical test result.

protocol_integrity.statement: The corrected canonical protocol isolates the test partition procedurally: the split is frozen first, exploration uses train only, the test is not used for adjustment, and it is opened once after selection and final fit are frozen. The same seed-42 test partition was nevertheless evaluated once by the superseded pre-correction execution, whose full-source exploration also informed the feature-policy design; it must not be described as never seen.

study_observations.description: Executing the study's official notebooks at the pinned revision in the Atlas session (CPython 3.13.13, locked packages, linux-x86_64) reproduced every canonical-run metric within 1e-9 and the model artifact / model-state fingerprints, while probability_matrix_sha256 differed; the study's own verifier therefore reports a runtime-dependent byte difference, not a scientific difference.

Notebook 03 evaluates validation candidates with estimator.predict (argmax in estimator class order) while the final evaluation takes the argmax over probabilities realigned to public order. The two coincide unless two class probabilities are exactly equal; Atlas applies one declared argmax rule and reports the number of exact ties.

limitations: Educational stratified random-snapshot benchmark; no temporal, prospective or operational validity.
The seed-42 test partition had historical exposure in the superseded pre-correction execution; the corrected run isolates it only procedurally.
ShapeFactor2 provenance is unresolved; only predictive sensitivity was evaluated.
Repeated feature profiles are a sensitivity analysis only; they do not prove duplicate identity or leakage, and the official test stays complete.
Class probabilities are not established as calibrated measures of biological certainty.
